core_obligations: Identify the fibre products of the coproduct with the coproducts of the pairwise fibre products, and likewise in higher degrees (proof lines 8488-8489).
Observe that giving a morphism to the coproduct is the same as giving a family of morphisms to its components (proof lines 8490-8491).
Conclude that giving a descent datum is the same as giving a family of comparison morphisms, which is the stated equivalence (proof lines 8491-8492).
proof_roadmap: Fibre products of the coproduct (proof lines 8488-8489).
Morphisms and data decompose componentwise (proof lines 8490-8492).
difficulty_reason: For a family of morphisms with target S and X the coproduct of their sources, the lemma produces a canonical equivalence between descent data relative to the family and descent data relative to the single morphism X to S, described explicitly on objects (statement lines 8466-8485). The proof is a direct unpacking: the fibre product of the coproduct with itself over S is the coproduct of the pairwise fibre products, and likewise for higher fibre products, so a morphism to X is the same as a family of morphisms to the components and a descent datum is the same as a family of comparison isomorphisms indexed by pairs (proof lines 8487-8492). The claim is H2: no construction beyond identifying the fibre products, which the author states and which is exactly the content.
